description.value: Fairmont Hot Springs Resort is a large, full-service mountain resort in BC's Columbia Valley, anchored by Canada's largest natural hot springs with a daily flow of over 1.2 million gallons. It offers a wide range of accommodations — from main lodge rooms and a motel-style Juniper Lodge to cabins, villas, an RV resort, and a riverside campground — along with two golf courses and a full spa. Touring cyclists arriving after a long day in the Rockies will find hot mineral pools, multiple on-site restaurants, and a fitness centre, making it a notably comfortable overnight stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a large, active full-service resort with multiple accommodation types, on-site dining, and extensive amenities. No cycling-specific facilities (bike storage, tools, wash station) are mentioned anywhere in the website content; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag is corroborated by website references to free Wi-Fi in the RV Resort and WiFi listed in Mountainside Villas. The RV park contact page lists a different phone number (250.345.6033) than the OSM record (+1-250-345-6070), suggesting the OSM number is the main lodge line — neither can be confirmed as wrong but the discrepancy is noted.
concerns: The RV park contact number listed on the website (/rv/rv-resort) is 250.345.6033, which differs from the OSM main phone of +1-250-345-6070. The OSM number is likely the main lodge line but could not be independently confirmed from the website content as captured.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, clearly active resort with multiple accommodation options, confirmed open with current 2026/27 season offerings. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists.
